Phantom Movies v1.5.5 restores instant update notifications, keeps the GitHub release update flow, and reconnects release pushes so future updates can notify users without opening the app.

Phantom Movies v1.5.0 brings a complete UI overhaul with a fresh dark interface, redesigned home and detail screens, improved TV season and episode browsing, better foldable device layouts, local watch history, and a new Phantom Movies player experience.
